As of **May 2024**, here is the exhaustive taxonomic classification of the genus *Tyrannosaurus*:

## **Currently Recognized Species**

### 1. **†*Tyrannosaurus rex*** Osborn, 1905
- **Status**: Type species, only universally accepted valid species
- **Time Period**: Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous (~69-66 mya)
- **Location**: Western North America
- **Characteristics**: Largest known tyrannosaurid, up to 13 meters long and ~8-14 tons weight

---

## **Proposed New Species (Validity Contested)**

### 2. **†*Tyrannosaurus mcraeensis*** Dalman et al., 2024
- **Publication**: January 11, 2024, in *Scientific Reports*
- **Type Specimen**: NMMNH P-3698 (partial skull and lower jaw elements)
- **Location**: Hall Lake Formation, Sierra County, New Mexico, USA
- **Age**: ~73.2 mya ± 0.7 million years (Campanian-Maastrichtian boundary)
- **Relationship**: Sister species to *T. rex*, not direct ancestor
- **Size**: Comparable to *T. rex* (~12 meters long, ~10 tons)
- **Current Status**: **Debatable** - While announced as a new species by Dalman et al., many paleontologists question whether it represents a distinct species or intraspecific variation of *T. rex*

---

## **Rejected / Invalid Historical Synonyms**

The following were historically assigned to *Tyrannosaurus* but are no longer recognized:

| Name | Year | Author | Current Status |
|------|------|--------|----------------|
| *Manospondylus gigas* | 1892 | Cope | Synonymized with *T. rex* |
| *Dynamosaurus imperiosus* | 1905 | Osborn | Original name before *rex*, synonymized |
| *Stygivenator amplus/molnari* | various | various | Rejected |
| *Tyrannosaurus amplus/imperiosus/regina* | various | various | All rejected as separate species |

---

## **Controversial/Rejected Modern Proposals**

| Proposed Species | Year | Author | Status |
|------------------|------|--------|--------|
| *Tyrannosaurus regina* | 2022 | Paul | Rejected |
| *Tyrannosaurus imperator* | 2022 | Paul | Rejected |
| *Nanotyrannus lancensis* | 1978 | Horner | Now considered juvenile *T. rex* |

---

## **Taxonomic Context**

- **Family**: †Tyrannosauridae
- **Subfamily**: Tyrannosaurinae
- **Tribe**: †Tyrannosaurini (defined as last common ancestor of Asian *Tarbosaurus bataar* and *T. rex* and all descendants)

---

## **Summary as of May 2024**

| Category | Count | Species |
|----------|-------|---------|
| **Universally Accepted** | 1 | *T. rex* |
| **Proposed New Species** | 1 | *T. mcraeensis* (contested) |
| **Validated Synonyms** | 0 | All historical names rejected |

**Key Takeaway**: The scientific consensus recognizes only one valid species (*T. rex*). The 2024 proposal of *T. mcraeensis* represents significant new research but remains controversial and has not achieved universal acceptance among paleontologists.
